name: Media Text Overlay
description: helps create a text overlay on images.
project_description:
This module provides a flexible way to create visually rich text overlays with background image.

 It allows editors to place text on top of images with configurable positioning options such as top-left, center, or bottom-right. The module focuses on simplicity and usability while still offering enough control for common design needs.

 Key features include: 
 
 Add text overlays to images 
 Predefined positioning (e.g., 9-point grid like top-left, center, bottom-right) or free drag to custom position 
 Responsive behavior of the text 
 
 The module is designed to be lightweight and developer-friendly, making it easy to extend or customize for advanced use cases.
